description: Roll on or browse D&D 5e SRD random tables (madness, poisons, diseases, personality traits). Use table_name "list" to see all available tables, or provide a specific table name with an optional roll result.

roll.description: A specific die roll result. If omitted, shows the full table.

table_name.description: Name of the table (e.g. "Short-Term Madness", "Poisons") or "list" to see all tables

name: roll_table
